title: Free Pop-Up Holiday Con: Springfield, Missouri
seo_title: Free Pop-Up Holiday Con in Springfield, MO
description: This is a free-admission holiday pop-up convention where visitors can get free photo ops with Santa Claus and the Grinch, and earn free 9"x12" prints by tagging someone on Instagram or sharing the event on Facebook. Another free print is offered for liking and following; photo op times and details are listed in the event FAQ. It runs Friday, December 11, 2026 at 5:00 PM through Sunday, December 13, 2026 at 6:00 PM at University Plaza Hotel & Convention Center, 333 S John Q Hammons Pkwy in Springfield, Missouri.
address: 333 S John Q Hammons Pkwy, Springfield, MO 65806-2543, United States, Springfield, MO
